parameters.description: Required except for create

execution.description: Captured stdoutBase64 and stderrBase64 decode to at most 1 MiB combined. For captured or truncated output, capturedBytes equals their decoded total. Not-captured, expired, and evicted output has no byte fields; not-captured output has capturedBytes 0.

AcceptedExecution.description: The operation must have kind exec and satisfy terminal status payload rules; operation.id equals execution.operationId, operation.executionId and any result.executionId equal execution.id, and their projectId and sandboxId values match.

operation.description: A succeeded operation has a same-kind result and no error. A failed operation has an error and no result. Queued, running, and unknown operations may omit both payloads. When present, an error effect or file-write receipt effect matches the operation effect; a create result sandboxId or exec result executionId matches the corresponding operation ID field.
